report.title: DAM Compliance Report - Database Activity Monitoring
report.author: DBDOME Security Team

sections.content: This report provides compliance evidence for database activity monitoring across PCI DSS 4.0, SOX, GDPR, and HIPAA regulatory frameworks. Generated automatically by the DBDOME monitoring platform.

sections.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT server) AS monitored_servers, COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS detection_rules, COUNT(*) AS total_executions, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed_findings, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' = 'critical' AND metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_findings FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
sections.template: In the last 24 hours: {monitored_servers} servers monitored, {detection_rules} detection rules executed, {total_executions} total checks performed. Confirmed findings: {confirmed_findings} (of which {critical_findings} critical).

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, COUNT(*) AS auth_findings FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AU%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY gm.server ORDER BY auth_findings DESC LIMIT 10
sections.title: Top 10 Servers - Authentication Findings (24h)
sections.caption: Authentication-related detection findings by server in the last 24 hours

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, COALESCE(rc.name, gm.metric_name) AS root_cause, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count')::int AS rows_found, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity', 'medium') AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = gm.metric_name WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AU%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-AZ%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC01%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC08%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS findings_count, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC12%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', gm.entry_date) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS sql_injection_attempts FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-INJ%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC06%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
sections.title: SQL Injection Attempts (7-Day Trend)
sections.caption: SQL injection detection trend over the last 7 days

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS attack_count, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC06%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC01' THEN 'Unknown Login' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC02' THEN 'Unexpected Program' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC03' THEN 'Unexpected Database' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC04' THEN 'Suspicious Patterns' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC05' THEN 'PII Access' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC06' THEN 'SQL Injection' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC07' THEN 'After Hours' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC08' THEN 'Privilege Escalation' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC09' THEN 'Data Exfiltration' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC10' THEN 'Multi-Host Login' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC11' THEN 'Schema Recon' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC12' THEN 'Dormant Account' WHEN metric_name LIKE '%%RC13' THEN 'Mass Modification' ELSE metric_name END AS anomaly_type, COUNT(*) AS finding_count FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010%%' AND metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY anomaly_type ORDER BY finding_count DESC
sections.title: Anomaly Findings by Type (24h)
sections.caption: Distribution of confirmed anomaly findings in the last 24 hours

sections.text: 5. SOX - Separation of Duties & Privilege Escalation (Section 404)

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS escalation_count, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC08%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS affected_rows, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC13%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', gm.entry_date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS pii_access_events FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC05%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
sections.title: PII Access Events (30-Day Trend)
sections.caption: Sensitive data access detections over the last 30 days

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS records_accessed, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC05%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, COALESCE(rc.name, gm.metric_name) AS root_cause, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count')::int AS rows_found, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity', 'medium') AS severity, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->'expected'->>'description') AS description, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = gm.metric_name WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-PRI%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC05%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 50

sections.content: This section tracks access to electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) across monitored databases. All access events are logged with user identity, timestamp, and action type.

sections.query: SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_name AS root_cause_id, COALESCE(rc.name, gm.metric_name) AS root_cause, (gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count')::int AS rows_found, COALESCE(gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity', 'medium') AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm LEFT JOIN rootcause.root_causes rc ON rc.root_cause_id = gm.metric_name WHERE (gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-PRI%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ENC%%' OR gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-DAT%%') AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT gm.server, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'row_count' AS suspicious_count, gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'severity' AS severity, gm.entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS detected_at FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC09%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY gm.entry_date DESC

SELECT gm.server, COUNT(*) AS after_hours_events FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results gm WHERE gm.metric_name LIKE 'SEC-SQL-ACC-010-RC07%%' AND gm.metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' AND gm.entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY gm.server ORDER BY after_hours_events DESC
sections.title: After-Hours Activity by Server (7 Days)
sections.caption: Database activity detected outside business hours (before 06:00 or after 22:00)

sections.query: SELECT server, metric_name AS alert_type, subject, entry_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jerusalem' AS sent_at FROM alerts.mail_alert_log WHERE entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY entry_date DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT server) AS servers, COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS rules_checked, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS findings, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_metadata_vs_expected::jsonb->>'matched' = 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clean FROM monitoring.general_metric_metadata_results WHERE entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
sections.template: Weekly compliance summary: {servers} servers monitored across {rules_checked} detection rules. Total findings: {findings}. Clean checks: {clean}.
